scheme_name: Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-II
other_conditions: Applicants must be students enrolled in polytechnic colleges or undergraduate (BSc) courses in Kerala
Proposals can be submitted as groups of up to 5 students
Maximum proposals per institution: 10 from a college, 4 from a department, or 2 from a principal investigator
Projects must be conducted under the guidance of a teacher
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹10,000 per project for a one‑year duration.
